## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Note compatibility changes.

## Validation

List commands run and results. For compiler/runtime changes, include relevant
real-runtime checks; for documentation-only changes, link/syntax checks suffice.

## Review notes

Call out dependency updates, generated docs, release implications, and changes to
credentials, input declarations, platform selection, or executable code paths.
Do not include vulnerability details here; follow SECURITY.md for private reports.
